saa-ini-073.text: A data science team will train large-scale machine learning models that depend on massively parallel processing. EC2 is the one indicated to accelerate this training?
options: Accelerated computing instances with GPU (as the P and G families)
General use T instances with burst
saa-ini-073.explanation: Accelerated computing families include GPUs designed for massive parallelism of deep learning training, reducing from days to hours unfeasible tasks on common CPUs.
saa-ini-073.hint: Deep learning training is synonymous with a specific type of chip — what kind of instance does it carry?
optionRationales: Accelerated computing families include GPUs designed for massive parallelism of deep learning training, reducing from days to hours unfeasible tasks on common CPUs.
The T instances meet light and intermittent charges with CPU — completely undersized for large-scale ML training.
The Family I Prefers IOPS of local disk for I/O intensive banks, and not the parallel calculation required by neural networks.
The M family balances CPU and memory for conventional loads — without accelerators, training would be slow and expensive.

saa-ini-074.text: A high-performance computing application (HPC) requires that a group of bodies EC2 communicate with minimum latency and maximum throughput between them. The architect decided to request that the AWS position these physically close instances in the same high capacity network segment. EC2 allows this positioning?
options: Placement group of the spread type
Auto Scaling Group with several AZs
saa-ini-074.explanation: The cluster placement group instructs to AWS to position the nearby instances within the same AZ, maximizing the throughput and minimizing the latency of communication between them — standard for the HPC and distributed coupled computing.
saa-ini-074.hint: For ultra-fast conversation between machines, ask AWS put them 'clustered' — what kind of group does that?
optionRationales: The cluster placement group instructs to AWS to position the nearby instances within the same AZ, maximizing the throughput and minimizing the latency of communication between them — standard for the HPC and distributed coupled computing.
The spreader does a OPOSTO: separates instances into different hardware to reduce correlated failures, increasing distance instead of approaching them..
Distributing instances between AZs improves availability, but AUMENTA the latency of communication between them — contrary to the objective of HPC.
Peering connects different VPCs; does not control the physical proximity of instances within the same network.

saa-ini-075.text: A function AWS Lambda The developer discovered that, in the Lambda, there is a single configuration that, when increased, also proportionally increases the power of CPU assigned to the function. What is this configuration?
options: The Region where the function is implemented
The number of aliases and published versions
The amount of memory configured for the function
saa-ini-075.explanation: No. Lambda, the memory is the performance control: the CPU (and the network) grows proportionally to the configured memory, so that increasing memory usually accelerates functions limited by processing.
saa-ini-075.hint: No. Lambda, a single button buys memory and CPU together — what is he?
optionRationales: No. Lambda, the memory is the performance control: the CPU (and the network) grows proportionally to the configured memory, so that increasing memory usually accelerates functions limited by processing.
Descriptive metadata have no influence on the allocated computational resources.
The region affects geographical latency up to users, but does not change the proportion of CPU assigned to implementation.
aliases and versions are used to control deployment and traffic — do not change the hardware allocated by invocation.

saa-ini-076.text: A company needs to process raw data terabytes using big data frameworks such as Apache Spark and Hadoop, providing managed clusters that can be created for each job and turned off at the end. AWS provides these managed big data clusters?
saa-ini-076.explanation: The EMR (Elastic MapReduces) provides and manages big data clusters with Spark, Hadoop, Hive and other frameworks, allowing you to scale them by job and close them after processing to save.
saa-ini-076.hint: Spark and Hadoop managed at AWS meet by a three-letter acronym inherited from 'MapReduce''.
optionRationales: The EMR (Elastic MapReduces) provides and manages big data clusters with Spark, Hadoop, Hive and other frameworks, allowing you to scale them by job and close them after processing to save.
The RDS is a managed transactional relational bank — does not execute distributed big data processing frameworks like Spark.
The Lambda performs short event-oriented functions with time limits and resources incompatible with terabyte jobs in distributed clusters.
Lightsail offers simplified virtual servers for small projects — without any big data cluster orchestration.

saa-ini-077.text: An application that runs on RDS The standard MySQL has reached the performance limit. The team wants to migrate to a MySQL-compatible bank that offers up to five times more throughput in the same hardware class, maintaining the compatibility of the queries.?
saa-ini-077.explanation: The Aurora was redesigned to the cloud with distributed storage itself, delivering up to 5x the standard MySQL throughput with full match of queries — the natural path of performance upgrade in RDS.
saa-ini-077.hint: It's the turbinated relational bank of the AWS that 'says MySQL' fluently.
optionRationales: The Aurora was redesigned to the cloud with distributed storage itself, delivering up to 5x the standard MySQL throughput with full match of queries — the natural path of performance upgrade in RDS.
The DynamoDB It's NoSQL: migrating would require rewriting the data model and queries — there is no compatibility with SQL of MySQL.
Redis is a cache/data structure in memory, not a persistent relational bank compatible with MySQL.
S3 + Athena attend analytical queries about files, not transactional application loads with MySQL semantics.

saa-ini-078.text: When comparing Redis and Memcached in Amazon ElastiCache, a team needs resources beyond simple cache: advanced data structures (lists, sorted sets for rankings), optional persistence and replication with automatic failover. Which engine meets these requirements?
saa-ini-078.explanation: Redis offers rich data structures (sorted sets for rankings, lists, hashes), optional persistence, replication and automatic failure — features that go beyond pure and simple cache.
saa-ini-078.hint: Ranks with ordered sets and automatic failover are registered trademarks of one of the two engines — the richest in features.
optionRationales: Redis offers rich data structures (sorted sets for rankings, lists, hashes), optional persistence, replication and automatic failure — features that go beyond pure and simple cache.
Memcached is a simple multithread key-value cache, without persistence, replication or advanced data structures — ideal only for pure and disposable cache.
The DAX is the specific cache of DynamoDB, not a general purpose cache engine available in ElastiCache.
The Aurora Serverless is a relational bench with automatic scalability — not a memory cache engine.

saa-ini-079.text: The Auto Scaling of an application was configured with a target tracking policy that maintains the average use of CPU of the group 50%. How this policy contributes to the consistent performance of implementation?
options: It adds or removes instances automatically to keep the metric in target value, preserving capacity clearance to absorb load variations
It migrates the application to larger instances automatically
It limits the CPU of each instance to 50% via operating system configuration
It turns off the application when the CPU is more than 50%
saa-ini-079.explanation: Target tracking works like a thermostat: adjusts the amount of instances continuously to keep the metric on target, ensuring that the group always has a break for peaks without excessive waste.
saa-ini-079.hint: It works as a thermostat: defined the ideal temperature of the metric, which it adjusts to keep it?
optionRationales: Target tracking works like a thermostat: adjusts the amount of instances continuously to keep the metric on target, ensuring that the group always has a break for peaks without excessive waste.
Politics does not restrict the CPU of the machines; it manages the NUMBER of instances so that the average of the group stays on target.
Passing the target triggers the ADDING of instances, never the shutdown of the application.
Target tracking scale horizontally (more/less instances of the same type); does not perform automatic vertical resizing.

saa-ini-080.text: A live broadcast of sports events needs to serve the same video content to hundreds of thousands of simultaneous viewers worldwide, without overloading the source servers. Amazon CloudFront reduces the burden on origin in this scenario?
options: The CloudFront compresses the source servers to increase their capacity
The Edge Locations serve the contents of the local cache, and only requests not found in the cache (cache miss) arrive at the source
The CloudFront automatically creates new instances EC2 of origin in each country
The CloudFront blocks the access of spectators beyond the limit of origin
saa-ini-080.explanation: The CloudFront responds to most of the requests (cache hit); the source is only consulted when the content is not cached, drastically reducing traffic and load on the source servers.
saa-ini-080.hint: Origin only works when the edge 'does not know the answer' — what is called this mechanism?
optionRationales: The CloudFront responds to most of the requests (cache hit); the source is only consulted when the content is not cached, drastically reducing traffic and load on the source servers.
The CloudFront does not provide source servers; it multiplies the capacity of ENTREGA by cache on the edges.
There is no 'server compression'; the load reduction comes from the distributed cache, which avoids repeated requests to the source.
The objective of the CDN is to meet the TODOS quality spectators — scaling delivery by edges, not denying access.

saa-ini-081.text: One API serverless built with API Gateway and AWS Lambda has slowness in the first requests after periods of inactivity, a phenomenon known as cold start. Lambda reduces this problem by maintaining pre-initiated and ready to respond running environments?
options: Publish the function in two regions
Add a Dead-letter to the function
saa-ini-081.explanation: Provided Competition maintains a defined number of run environments already initialized, eliminating cold start for these requests — indicated resource for latency-sensitive APIs.
saa-ini-081.hint: The solution is to leave 'already connected and heated' engines waiting for the requests — what resource does this provide?
optionRationales: Provided Competition maintains a defined number of run environments already initialized, eliminating cold start for these requests — indicated resource for latency-sensitive APIs.
Timeout sets the maximum execution time allowed — does not speed up startup or avoid cold startups.
A DLQ captures events that failed in asynchronous processing; has no effect on initialization latency.
Multi-Region improves resilience and geographical latency, but each region would continue to suffer its own cold start.

saa-ini-082.text: Users of an internal corporate application complain of slowness. The investigation showed that traffic between the application servers and the database crosses different availability zones unnecessarily in each query. In addition to the transfer cost, what performance feature explains the improvement when approaching layers?
options: Communication within the same AZ has lower latency than between distinct AZs, reducing the time of each consultation
Databases do not work outside the application servers AZ
Traffic between AZs is limited to 1 Mbps by connection
Consultations between AZs need manual approval from the administrator
saa-ini-082.explanation: AZs are physically separated installations: traffic between them travels longer distance and adds latency to each round and round — placing talking layers in the same AZ (redundantly in others) reduces the accumulated response time.
saa-ini-082.hint: Every mile between data centers charges a toll in milliseconds — what happens when layers talk 'in the same building'?
optionRationales: AZs are physically separated installations: traffic between them travels longer distance and adds latency to each round and round — placing talking layers in the same AZ (redundantly in others) reduces the accumulated response time.
There is no such limit: the network between AZs is of high capacity; the relevant difference is the additional latency and the cost per GB.
There is no manual approval in traffic between AZs — communication is transparent, only with different physical characteristics.
Banks normally operate in distinct AZs (is the basis of Multi-AZ); the issue is the increase in latency in each interaction, not the impossibility.

saa-ini-083.text: A system ERP wheel 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, in instances EC2, and the company is sure that the load will continue the same for the next three years. Which purchasing model significantly reduces the cost of these instances in exchange for a long-term usage commitment?
options: Reserved Instances (Cases reserved) with a time limit of 1 or 3 years
saa-ini-083.explanation: Reserved Entities exchange the commitment of continuous use for discounts of up to 72% on On-Demand — the classic model for long-term stable and predictable loads.
saa-ini-083.hint: Stable load + years of predictability = exchange flexibility per discount with a long-term commitment.
optionRationales: Reserved Entities exchange the commitment of continuous use for discounts of up to 72% on On-Demand — the classic model for long-term stable and predictable loads.
On-Demand charges the full rate for flexibility without compromise — the most expensive option for a load that will prove to be rolling continuously for years.
Courts Spot may be interrupted by AWS at any time with two minutes notice — unacceptable for a ERP continuous production.
Dedicated hosts allocate entire physical servers for licensing/compliance requirements, being one of the most expensive options — not a discount mechanism.

saa-ini-084.text: A company uses a mixture of EC2, AWS Fargate and AWS Lambda, and you want a discount based on a fixed spending commitment per hour (in dollars) during 1 or 3 years, maintaining the freedom to exchange family of instance, Region and even computer service. saa-ini-084.hint: Commitment in dollars per hour + freedom to exchange computer service = the most flexible 'economy plan'.
optionRationales: The Computers Savings Plans apply the discount automatically on any eligible computer use (EC2 of any family/region, Fargate and Lambda) in exchange for the hourly expenditure commitment — the most flexible option of discount per commitment.
Standard RIs tied the discount to specific attributes (family, region), without covering Fargate and Lambda — much less flexibility than required.
Spot does not involve commitment or guarantee a fixed discount — is interruptible idle capacity, inadequate as a predictable economy contract.
Intelligent-Tiering is a class of ARMAZENAMENTO of the S3 — has no relation to computational discounts.
